scope: Primary source pages reviewed for stated capabilities/limitations; not pinned dependencies, full code audits, local installations or rights clearance.

sources.title: ComfyUI Qwen node source
sources.opportunity: Native TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus exposes image1/image2/image3; preserve slot order.
sources.caveat: Mutable source reviewed; validate against the installed node snapshot, not this URL alone.

sources.title: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511
sources.opportunity: Reference editing candidate behind the existing Studio graph.
sources.caveat: No additional inference performed; semantic control is not protected-pixel identity.

sources.title: BFL multi-reference guidance
sources.opportunity: Explicit references for identity, style and composition; dev recommended max six.
sources.caveat: Do not transfer hosted/playground input limits to a local model or node.

sources.title: Native ComfyUI FLUX.2 Klein
sources.opportunity: Fast reference editing and base/distilled alternatives.
sources.caveat: Model size, encoder, adapter and schedule must match; CUDA demo timings are not Radeon measurements.

sources.title: OmniGen2
sources.opportunity: Independent instruction and multi-reference image-generation research.
sources.caveat: Candidate to compare, not an installation or quality ranking.

sources.title: IPAdapter Plus
sources.opportunity: Mature appearance/style/composition conditioning for matched models.
sources.caveat: Maintainer labels project maintenance-only; pin dependencies and do not assume active feature work.

sources.title: Xinsir ControlNet Union SDXL
sources.opportunity: Structural pose/depth/line-art control; distinguish standard and ProMax.
sources.caveat: Hint preprocessor, ControlNet model and loader mode are separate dependencies.

sources.title: Qwen-Image-Layered
sources.opportunity: Image-to-RGBA-layer decomposition, useful before painting/editing.
sources.caveat: 20B-class candidate; arbitrary decomposition does not guarantee named bones, hidden limb art or a puppet rig.

sources.title: Qwen multi-angle adapter
sources.opportunity: Creator-published viewpoint adapter for a controlled turnaround experiment.
sources.caveat: Unseen geometry remains a proposal; cannot establish measured 3D consistency.

sources.title: Krita Python scripting
sources.opportunity: Native application plugin entry point for document/layer operations.
sources.caveat: Python API lives in Krita; arbitrary external Python cannot simply import a headless Krita runtime.

sources.title: Krita AI Diffusion
sources.opportunity: Painting and masked iterative generation through an existing canvas.
sources.caveat: Validate plugin/backend pair and keep editable source; no live session tested here.

sources.title: Community Krita MCP bridge
sources.opportunity: Layer/drawing/export control with canvas PNG feedback for an agent.
sources.caveat: Experimental; broad run_python permission and documented intermittent close_document crash require isolation/review.

sources.title: BlenderLayer for Krita
sources.opportunity: 3D reference/render layer inside a painting workflow.
sources.caveat: Candidate bridge, not a certified installation or substitute for geometry acceptance.

sources.title: Blender MCP
sources.opportunity: Agent control and viewport feedback around Blender.
sources.caveat: Arbitrary bpy execution is high-privilege; inspect telemetry, remote integrations and bind settings before use.

sources.title: Aseprite CLI
sources.opportunity: Batch sprite sheets, frame tags and JSON export.
sources.caveat: Use appropriately licensed installation; source availability does not mean unrestricted free binaries.

sources.title: OpenRaster file layout
sources.opportunity: Portable layer archive contract used by this package.
sources.caveat: A flat raster interchange format is not a native animation or rig project.

sources.title: OpenRaster layer stack
sources.opportunity: First layer uppermost; normal source-over compositing and named layers.
sources.caveat: Exporter deliberately rejects unsupported blend modes instead of silently flattening them.

sources.title: LayerInbetween, SIGGRAPH 2026
sources.opportunity: Editable vector stroke correspondence, occlusion handling and inbetweening from keyframes.
sources.caveat: Needs raster keyframes plus an initial SVG; separate SAM2 environment, external model terms and pickle checkpoint audit.

sources.title: ToonComposer
sources.opportunity: Colored reference plus sparse timed sketches for cartoon inbetweening/colorization.
sources.caveat: Author reports about 57GB VRAM for a 480p 61-frame example. Not a default RX9070XT recipe.

sources.title: ToonComposer terms
sources.opportunity: MIT grant for this project subject to enumerated third-party terms.
sources.caveat: Do not infer one Tencent release licence from another; assess each exact bundle.

sources.title: ToonCrafter
sources.opportunity: Older generative cartoon interpolation baseline between approved keyframes.
sources.caveat: Limited short clips; renderer output is not inherently alpha-correct or gameplay-consistent.

sources.title: UniAnimate-DiT
sources.opportunity: Reference and pose-driven human animation research.
sources.caveat: Wan2.1-derived video pipeline; offload examples do not certify AMD support or deliver a skeleton.

sources.title: OpenToonz Headless community fork
sources.opportunity: JSON-RPC/stdin automation research for a traditional 2D animation tool.
sources.caveat: Experimental fork with code evaluation; not the official OpenToonz headless API or an audited daemon.

sources.title: TRELLIS.2
sources.opportunity: Image-to-3D/PBR research candidate.
sources.caveat: Official Linux/NVIDIA path requires at least 24GB VRAM; Windows Radeon feasibility not established.

sources.title: TripoSG
sources.opportunity: Alternative shape generation candidate for a shared prop benchmark.
sources.caveat: Check compiled dependencies, hidden surfaces and topology; not a game-ready guarantee.

sources.title: PartCrafter
sources.opportunity: Part-aware mesh proposals for articulated props and objects.
sources.caveat: Explicit part counts avoid optional remote Gemini assistance; background removal and dependencies have separate terms.

sources.title: SAM 3D Objects
sources.opportunity: Object reconstruction from observed imagery.
sources.caveat: Reconstruction, licensing and game mesh/UV/rig suitability need independent checks.

sources.title: UniRig
sources.opportunity: Skeleton and skinning proposal for a clean mesh.
sources.caveat: Test stress poses, weights and attachments before accepting the rig.

sources.title: DART / DartControl
sources.opportunity: Text/action timelines, keyframe inbetweening and trajectory-guided skeletal motion.
sources.caveat: SMPL/SMPL-X and motion-data terms remain separate; retargeting/contact cleanup are still necessary.

sources.title: HY-Motion 1.0
sources.opportunity: Text-to-human-motion research reference.
sources.caveat: Standard grant excludes UK; documented limitations include no seamless-loop or in-place generation.

sources.title: HY-Motion licence
sources.opportunity: Exact territorial restriction evidence.
sources.caveat: Not licensed for the UK under this standard grant; separate authorization would be needed.

sources.title: Hunyuan3D 2.1
sources.opportunity: Geometry/texturing research reference rather than default local recommendation.
sources.caveat: Read exact licence before use, not a generic open-weights badge.

sources.title: Hunyuan3D 2.1 licence
sources.opportunity: Standard grant excludes UK, EU and South Korea and restricts output use outside territory.
sources.caveat: Corrects the earlier frontier shortlist: do not schedule UK usage under this grant.

sources.title: Material Maker
sources.opportunity: Procedural material structure alongside generated appearance.
sources.caveat: Test tiling, physical scale, normals, roughness and color-space assumptions in engine.

sources.title: Godot SpriteFrames
sources.opportunity: Engine clip frame regions and relative-duration contract.
sources.caveat: Absolute seconds equal relative duration divided by animation fps and playing speed.

sources.title: Khronos glTF Validator
sources.opportunity: Structural GLB/glTF, buffer and animation validation with JSON report.
sources.caveat: Passing structure does not prove correct skinning, contacts, art or target-engine behavior.

sources.title: Pillow 12.3.0
sources.opportunity: Pinned optional dependency matching the tested media environment.
sources.caveat: Install in asset-finishing venv; no change to Comfy Torch/ROCm required.
